graph_use_case_templates.name: Capital Programme Intelligence
graph_use_case_templates.description: One model over the budget cube, the ledger, the approval chain and the project attribute registry, so a capital question resolves once and states which vintage, which basis and which scope it was answered at.

graph_metrics.name: Total_Forecast_Remaining_Large_Proj
graph_metrics.definition: Total_Forecast_Remaining_Large_Proj = [Sum of FY26 Working Forecast]-[Sum of FY26 YearTotal Actual]+[Sum of FY27 Working Budget]+[Sum of FY28 Working Budget]+[Sum of FY29 Working Budget]+[Sum of FY30 Working Budget]+[Sum of FY31 Working Budget]+[Sum of FY32 Working Budget]

graph_metrics.name: Budget_Consumed_to_Date
graph_metrics.definition: Budget_Consumed_to_Date = [Inception to Date (ITD) Actuals] / [Most Recent Budget Plan in PeopleSoft (Value)]

graph_metrics.name: Forecast Bud Consumed at Completion
graph_metrics.definition: Forecast Bud Consumed at Completion = [Total_Anticipated_Cost] / [Most Recent Budget Plan in PeopleSoft (Value)]

graph_metrics.name: Year-to-Date (YTD) Budget Variance
graph_metrics.definition: FY26 YearTotal Actual (Actual YTD) - FY26 January_Calendarization Budget YTD (Budget YTD)

graph_metrics.name: Overrun amount
graph_metrics.definition:
Overrun Amount =
VAR ExceptionCategories =
    { "Network blankets", "Lead Capex Budget Category", "Meter blankets", "Plant roll-up" }
VAR ExceptionActuals =
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( 'EPBCS_DATA_2'[FY26 YearTotal Actual] ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( 'EPBCS_DATA_2'[Budget Category] IN ExceptionCategories )
    )
VAR StandardActuals =
    CALCULATE (
        SUM ( 'EPBCS_DATA_2'[Inception to Date (ITD) Actuals] ),
        KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ( 'EPBCS_DATA_2'[Budget Category] IN ExceptionCategories ) )
    )
RETURN
    ExceptionActuals + StandardActuals
        - SUM ( 'EPBCS_DATA_2'[Most Recent Budget Plan in PeopleSoft (Value)] )
